fields.Name: T217 - Developer Tools App State Inspector Section Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the tab-nav-driven read-only snapshot switching (onTabChange + StateJson) - the runtime-state snapshot inspector, a distinct data source and interaction not covered by any other DevTools test.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'App State'. It renders a read-only JSON snapshot of Explorer runtime state under a section tab-nav (e.g. sections for user, provider, workspace). Click a different section tab and confirm the section title updates AND the read-only JSON editor content changes to that section's snapshot. Success is the tab-nav switching the displayed JSON snapshot. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The App State inspector shows a section tab-nav and a read-only JSON snapshot in a code editor
Selecting a different section tab updates the section title and swaps the JSON content shown, confirming section navigation works
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
